matched_dominant_kernel_pairs.category: FP32 Attention Softmax (Row Max + Exp-Subtract-Sum Reductions)

matched_dominant_kernel_pairs.tflite_delegate_op: Delegate/Fully Connected (NC, QD8, F32, QC8W) GEMM
matched_dominant_kernel_pairs.why_dominant: All 190 ViT linear layers and the Vision Adapter use 8-bit QC8W weights; both XNNPACK and YNNPACK dispatch hardware AMX-INT8 (TDPBSSD), with XNNPACK fusing FP32 dequantization into the tile epilogue.

xnnpack_kernel.runtime_params: mr=5, nc in {1024, 4096}, kc in {1024, 4096}, a_stride=K, cm_stride=N

matched_dominant_kernel_pairs.why_dominant: 108 of 122 Conformer linear projections use 2-bit weights (i2); neither backend has an AMX 2-bit kernel, so both execute VNNI dot-product kernels with bit-unpacking.

shapes.journey: Minimum supported text shape (single-token boundary probe)
shapes.rationale: Minimum valid text input/output shape in LiteRT-LM: 1 prompt token + 1 decode token at the minimum KV cache capacity (max_num_tokens=1024, required by prefill_1024 DYNAMIC_UPDATE_SLICE validation). Isolates pure single-row GEMV (M=1) without any prefill_128 or prefill_1024 GEMM invocation.

Short 16-token user command followed by a 128-token response. Exercises the small prefill_128 bucket once, with >95% of wall time governed by 128 memory-bandwidth-bound decode steps (M=1 AVX-512 VNNI dot products).
Typical single-turn conversational exchange (~50 words in, ~50 words out). Fits within a single prefill_128 bucket and stays well inside the 1024-token local sliding-window attention horizon.

shapes.journey: Full prefill_128 bucket boundary / IDE code completion
shapes.rationale: Saturates the 128-token prefill signature bucket (127 tokens in prefill_128 + 1st decode token) before transitioning to prefill_1024, balancing M=128 AMX/AVX-512 prefill GEMM against 128 M=1 decode steps.

shapes.journey: RAG snippet Q&A / multi-turn chat (or 280-token image soft-token prefill)
shapes.rationale: Crosses the 128-token threshold, triggering LiteRT-LM's prefill_1024 signature (M=1024 GEMM with 255 active tokens) followed by 128 decode steps.

shapes.journey: Document summarization / headline CPU benchmark workload
shapes.rationale: Headline ai-edge-bench CPU workload: saturates a full 1024-token prefill_1024 invocation and reaches the exact boundary of Gemma 4 31B's 50 local sliding-window attention layers (sliding_window=1024) while decoding into a 4096-token KV cache.

4x the sliding window (4096 > 1024): local attention layers remain capped at W=1024 while the 10 global attention layers scale quadratically in prefill and linearly in decode across 4096 KV cache entries, shifting time share toward BatchMatMul, Softmax, RoPE, and KV cache slice updates.

shapes.journey: Maximum supported KV cache capacity (32K context window)
shapes.rationale: Tests the model at LiteRT-LM's maximum exported KV cache capacity (max_num_tokens=32768, magic number 32771). Above 32K (at 65536), the global attention score tensor [1, 32, 1024, 65536] reaches 2^31 elements (8.59 GB FP32), exceeding signed 32-bit tensor indexing (INT32_MAX) in TFLite flatbuffers.

shapes.journey: Minimum vision soft-token budget (70 soft tokens / 630 16x16 patches)
shapes.rationale: Minimum supported image soft-token budget in Gemma4ImageProcessor (_SUPPORTED_SOFT_TOKENS = (70, 140, 280, 560, 1120)): 630 16x16 patches (e.g., 280x560 thumbnail / icon inspection) pooled 3x3 (9:1) into 70 soft tokens. At N_patches=630, 8-bit QC8W linear projections (AMX-INT8) and 2D ONE_HOT position embeddings outweigh quadratic O(N_patches^2) vision self-attention.

shapes.journey: Low-resolution mobile camera / product photo VQA (140 soft tokens / 1,260 patches)
shapes.rationale: Second supported Gemma 4 vision budget: 1,260 16x16 patches (e.g., 560x576 image) pooled 9:1 into 140 soft tokens. Represents fast mobile VQA where QC8W AMX-INT8 projections and FP32 BatchMatMul attention reach parity.

shapes.journey: Standard single-image multimodal chat (280 soft tokens / 2,520 patches)
shapes.rationale: Default LiteRT-LM vision export budget (vision_max_num_tokens=280): 2,520 16x16 patches (e.g., 672x960 photo) pooled 9:1 into 280 soft tokens. Bidirectional FP32 self-attention [1, 16, 2520, 2520] becomes the primary bottleneck (~45% of ViT time), followed by 190 QC8W AMX-INT8 linear projections.

shapes.journey: High-resolution OCR, receipt & chart reading (560 soft tokens / 5,040 patches)
shapes.rationale: High-resolution OCR budget: 5,040 16x16 patches (e.g., 960x1344 document/chart) pooled 9:1 into 560 soft tokens. Quadratic unmasked 2D self-attention [1, 16, 5040, 5040] and Softmax exceed 65% of total vision encoding time.

shapes.journey: Maximum vision soft-token budget / dense full-page PDF (1,120 soft tokens / 10,080 patches)
shapes.rationale: Maximum supported image soft-token budget in Gemma4ImageProcessor (max_soft_tokens=1120, max_patches=10080, e.g., 1344x1920 dense screenshot/PDF). Each of the 27 ViT layers computes a [1, 16, 10080, 10080] attention matrix (6.5 GB FP32 per layer across 16 heads), making FP32 BatchMatMul + Softmax >80% of total vision execution time.

shapes.journey: Speech clip transcription / audio Q&A (~8.16s audio, 816 mel frames -> 204 soft tokens)
shapes.rationale: Note: Official google/gemma-4-31B-it has audio_config=null (Vision+Text only); only Gemma 4 E2B and E4B include model.audio_tower. Included as the Gemma 4 family audio reference (profiled from gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm on Sapphire Rapids): 816 128-bin log-mel frames (~8.16s speech) subsampled 4x by the Conformer encoder into 204 audio soft tokens, exercising INT2/INT4 Conformer linear projections, DepthwiseConv2D, and relative-position attention.
